opening.argument: The speaker promotes Forsage as an online business and earning opportunity, then instructs viewers to recruit prospects through Facebook, Instagram, and Telegram. He emphasizes the money available and the prospect of forming a large team. Those claims connect the earning pathway to getting other people to join. The outreach advice also calls for building relationships, creating curiosity, and withholding clear business details until prospects make contact. Taken together, the income pitch, team-building goal, and staged disclosure establish a recruitment-driven scam solicitation. The presentation actively seeks new participants through social-media prospecting rather than merely teaching viewers how to use those platforms.
